## What's new

### Daily activity heatmap
- The AI usage view now shows your token usage per day as a
  GitHub-contributions-style grid, below the Claude Code and Codex cards.
- Days are grouped in your PC's time zone. The grid shows as many recent
  weeks as fit the panel (up to 53), with month and weekday labels.
- Four shades, based on the days you used; hover a day for the date, token
  total and the Claude Code / Codex split.

### Workspace numbers follow the panel order
- Workspace numbers are now positions in the panel. Delete workspace 2 and
  the old 3 becomes 2; reordering renumbers too.
- `Ctrl+Alt+1`–`9` (`Cmd+1`–`9` on macOS), the command palette, notes and
  tooltips use the same numbers. Saved scrollback, notes and drafts are
  unaffected.
- Pressing a number beyond your last workspace no longer creates one; use
  the **+** button.
